features: Existing last-ten accepted team outcomes and last-three accepted starter appearances; same-day excluded; completion strictly before target start minus 60 minutes
appearance_rule: Copy pinned strict outcome/appearance rules with season bound to source date, plus existing corroborated runner-out classifier; no source normalization
gap_rule: Every refused or uncollected earlier occurrence blocks history unless same-feed participant evidence excludes the pitcher or places the complete game before all three selected appearances
participant_rule: Existing v2 participant superset checks and reviewed postponed no-play intervals, with season bound to source date. Intervals exclude only before the explicit rescheduled start; suspended games remain refused.
selection: Repeated schedule occurrences refuse appearance statistics and target starter selection; a unique matching final occurrence may certify participant absence only
